title: The fire pans become a covering for the altar
description: The Lord commands the priest Eleazar, son of Aaron, to take up the fire pans from the burnt site after Korah's company and scatter the embers far away, for the pans have become holy. The copper pans are hammered into plates to serve as a covering on the altar, as a sign and memorial to the Israelites that no outsider who is not of Aaron's descendants shall approach to burn incense before the Lord – so that they do not meet the same fate as Korah and his company. [ref:Num 17:1-5|Numbers 17:1-5]
